Open-source resume layout adaptations

These six layouts adapt the listed MIT-licensed sources to LinkResume canonical content and shared editor/print CSS. They are not pixel-identical ports. Upstream photographs, sample personal data, fonts, icon packs and JavaScript dependencies are not included.

灰阶章节索引 (open-even-cn)
Source: https://github.com/rbardini/jsonresume-theme-even/tree/8231a31977aa7bfc7c1724713b523a85f32a760d
Files: assets/page.css
Changes: Chinese canonical content, local typography, shared editable/print selectors and A4 spacing.

学术短线履历 (open-moderncv-cn)
Source: https://github.com/rendercv/rendercv-typst/tree/71e22e0692fc84518b2255974cf693b3334ab928
Files: lib.typ; examples/moderncv.typ
Changes: Chinese canonical content, local typography, shared editable/print selectors and A4 spacing.
